impact.en: Loose objects blown by wind in a few areas
impact.sw: Vitu vilivyolegea kupeperushwa na upepo katika maeneo machache

en: Secure or bring inside loose roofing sheets, laundry, tools and signboards.
Weigh down the roofs of kiosks and temporary structures.
sw: Funga au ingiza ndani mabati yaliyolegea, nguo, vifaa na mabango.
Weka uzito juu ya paa za vibanda na majengo ya muda.

impact.en: Higher risk for children, older persons and people with disabilities
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa zaidi kwa watoto, wazee na watu wenye ulemavu

en: Village/Mtaa and Ward Disaster Management Committees: review contingency plans, update the list of people with special needs and identify solid buildings for shelter.
Share this advisory with neighbours, especially older persons, people with disabilities and pregnant women.
Keep young children indoors during strong gusts.
sw: Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Vijiji/Mitaa na Kata: pitieni mipango ya dharura, boresheni orodha ya watu wenye mahitaji maalum na bainisheni majengo imara ya kujikinga.
Wapatie taarifa hii majirani, hasa wazee, watu wenye ulemavu na wajawazito.
Waweke watoto wadogo ndani wakati wa upepo mkali.

impact.en: Difficulty controlling lorries, buses and motorcycles on exposed roads
impact.sw: Ugumu wa kudhibiti malori, mabasi na pikipiki kwenye barabara za wazi

en: Drivers: slow down on exposed roads and bridges.
Motorcyclists and cyclists: take extra care in gusts.
sw: Madereva: punguzeni mwendo kwenye barabara za wazi na madaraja.
Waendesha pikipiki na baiskeli: chukueni tahadhari zaidi wakati wa upepo mkali.

impact.en: Weak roofs and small branches at risk of being blown off
impact.sw: Paa dhaifu na matawi madogo kuwa hatarini kupeperushwa

en: Please nail or tie down loose roofing sheets before the winds arrive.
Repair weak roofs.
Trim weak branches near houses.
sw: Tafadhali pigilia au funga mabati yaliyolegea kabla upepo haujafika.
Karabati paa dhaifu.
Punguza matawi dhaifu yaliyo karibu na nyumba.

impact.en: Disruption to outdoor activities and markets
impact.sw: Kuathirika kwa shughuli za nje na masoko

en: Secure market stalls and tents.
Postpone outdoor events in exposed areas.
Follow forecasts from the Tanzania Meteorological Authority (TMA).
sw: Funga vizuri meza za biashara na mahema.
Ahirisha shughuli za nje katika maeneo ya wazi.
Fuatilia utabiri wa Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania (TMA).

impact.en: Higher waves on the sea and lakes, risky for small boats
impact.sw: Mawimbi makubwa baharini na maziwani, hatari kwa vyombo vidogo

en: Fishers and boat operators: check TMA forecasts before going out.
Wear a life jacket.
Do not overload boats.
sw: Wavuvi na waendesha vyombo vya majini: fuatilieni utabiri wa TMA kabla ya kutoka.
Vaa jaketi ya kujiokoa.
Usizidishe mzigo kwenye chombo.

impact.en: Dust reducing visibility in dry areas
impact.sw: Vumbi kupunguza uwezo wa kuona katika maeneo makavu

en: Drive slowly with headlights on.
People with asthma or chest conditions: stay indoors.
Cover drinking water and food.
sw: Endesha taratibu ukiwasha taa za mbele.
Watu wenye pumu au matatizo ya kifua: bakini ndani.
Funika maji ya kunywa na chakula.

impact.en: Falling branches endangering people and vehicles
impact.sw: Matawi yanayoanguka kuhatarisha watu na magari

en: Park away from trees and weak walls.
Report dangerous trees to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Egesha mbali na miti na kuta dhaifu.
Toa taarifa ya miti hatari kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Damage to banana plants, fruit trees and flowering crops
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa migomba, miti ya matunda na mazao yanayochanua

en: Stake banana plants and young crops.
Harvest mature fruit early.
Secure shade nets and nursery structures.
sw: Weka miti ya kuegemeza migomba na mazao machanga.
Vuna matunda yaliyokomaa mapema.
Funga vizuri nyavu za kivuli na vitalu.

impact.en: Brief power cuts from swaying lines
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa umeme kwa muda mfupi kutokana na nyaya kuyumba

en: Charge phones and torches.
Keep away from fallen power lines.
Report sparking or fallen lines to TANESCO.
sw: Chaji simu na tochi.
Kaa mbali na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka.
Toa taarifa ya nyaya zinazotoa cheche au zilizoanguka kwa TANESCO.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This advisory remains in place until the authorities update or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea hadi mamlaka zitakapoihuisha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Damaging winds and gusts in many areas
impact.sw: Upepo mkali unaoleta madhara katika maeneo mengi

en: Stay inside a solid building while the winds last.
Households in weak houses: move to a solid building before the winds arrive.
District and Ward Disaster Management Committees: meet, activate contingency plans, prepare rescue teams and shelters, and alert communities by radio, loudspeaker and door-to-door.
sw: Kaa ndani ya jengo imara muda wote wa upepo mkali.
Kaya zilizo kwenye nyumba dhaifu: hamieni jengo imara kabla upepo haujafika.

Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Wilaya na Kata: kutaneni, amilisheni mipango ya dharura, andaeni timu za uokoaji na makazi ya muda, na toeni tahadhari kwa jamii kupitia redio, vipaza sauti na nyumba kwa nyumba.

impact.en: Flying roofing sheets and debris causing injuries
impact.sw: Mabati na vitu vinavyopeperushwa kusababisha majeraha

en: Stay away from windows and doors.
Do not go outside unless necessary.
Do not try to hold down roofing sheets during the wind.
sw: Kaa mbali na madirisha na milango.
Usitoke nje isipokuwa ni lazima.
Usijaribu kushikilia mabati wakati wa upepo.

impact.en: Fallen trees blocking roads and damaging power lines
impact.sw: Miti iliyoanguka kuziba barabara na kuharibu nyaya za umeme

en: Do not shelter under trees.
Keep away from fallen power lines.
Report fallen lines to TANESCO and blocked roads to TARURA or TANROADS.
sw: Usijikinge chini ya miti.
Kaa mbali na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka.
Toa taarifa ya nyaya zilizoanguka kwa TANESCO na barabara zilizozibwa kwa TARURA au TANROADS.

impact.en: Roofs blown off and weak buildings damaged
impact.sw: Paa kuezuliwa na majengo dhaifu kuharibika

en: Leave buildings with loose roofs or cracked walls.
Do not use damaged classrooms, churches, mosques or halls.
Report damage to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Ondoka kwenye majengo yenye paa zilizolegea au kuta zenye nyufa.
Usitumie madarasa, makanisa, misikiti au kumbi zilizoharibika.
Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Travel delays and disruption on roads
impact.sw: Ucheleweshaji wa safari na usumbufu barabarani

en: Avoid non-essential travel.
Lorries, buses and motorcycles: avoid exposed roads and bridges.
Follow instructions from the Traffic Police.
sw: Epuka safari zisizo za lazima.
Malori, mabasi na pikipiki: epukeni barabara za wazi na madaraja.
Fuata maelekezo ya Polisi wa Usalama Barabarani.

impact.en: Widespread power cuts
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa umeme katika maeneo mengi

en: Store water, food and medicines for at least three days.
Keep torches ready.
Switch off electrical appliances during power cuts.
sw: Hifadhi maji, chakula na dawa za angalau siku tatu.
Weka tochi tayari.
Zima vifaa vya umeme wakati umeme umekatika.

impact.en: Disruption to mobile networks
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa mitandao ya simu

en: Charge phones and keep a battery-powered radio.
Agree a family meeting point.
sw: Chaji simu na uwe na redio inayotumia betri.
Kubalianeni mahali pa kukutana kama familia.

impact.en: Dangerous waves on the sea and lakes
impact.sw: Mawimbi hatari baharini na maziwani

en: Fishers and boat operators: please do not go out; those already out, return to shore.
Beach Management Units: stop boats from leaving landing sites.
Report missing boats immediately to the Police or call 190.
sw: Wavuvi na waendesha vyombo vya majini: tafadhali msitoke; walio majini rudini ufukweni.
Vikundi vya Usimamizi wa Mialo (BMU): zuieni vyombo kutoka mialoni.
Toa taarifa ya vyombo vilivyopotea mara moja kwa Polisi au piga 190.

impact.en: Damage to standing crops, banana plants and fruit trees
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa mazao yaliyo shambani, migomba na miti ya matunda

en: Harvest mature crops early.
Stay out of fields and plantations during the winds.
Report damage to extension officers.
sw: Vuna mazao yaliyokomaa mapema.
Usiingie mashambani wakati wa upepo.
Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa maafisa ugani.

impact.en: Dust storms reducing visibility in dry areas
impact.sw: Dhoruba za vumbi kupunguza uwezo wa kuona katika maeneo makavu

en: Avoid travel during dust storms.
Close doors and windows.
People with chest conditions: cover your nose and mouth.
sw: Epuka kusafiri wakati wa dhoruba za vumbi.
Funga milango na madirisha.
Watu wenye matatizo ya kifua: funikeni pua na mdomo.

impact.en: Disruption to schools and markets
impact.sw: Kuathirika kwa shule na masoko

en: School heads: keep pupils in solid classrooms; do not use classrooms with loose roofs.
Follow directives from the District Education Office.
Market traders: close and secure stalls.
sw: Wakuu wa shule: bakisheni wanafunzi kwenye madarasa imara; msitumie madarasa yenye paa zilizolegea.
Fuateni maelekezo ya Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya.
Wafanyabiashara wa masoko: fungeni na imarisheni meza na vibanda.

impact.en: Risk of injury at construction sites
impact.sw: Hatari ya majeraha katika maeneo ya ujenzi

en: Stop work at height and crane operations.
Secure scaffolding and loose materials.
Keep people away from construction sites.
sw: Sitisha kazi za juu na matumizi ya winchi.
Funga vizuri majukwaa ya ujenzi na vifaa vilivyolegea.
Zuia watu kukaribia maeneo ya ujenzi.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This warning remains in force until the authorities lower or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea kutumika hadi mamlaka zitakapoishusha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Severe winds affecting whole communities
impact.sw: Upepo mkali sana unaoathiri jamii nzima

en: Stay inside the strongest room of a solid building.
Do not go outside until the authorities announce that the winds have passed.
If the building starts to break up, move to the strongest corner and protect your head.
sw: Kaa ndani ya chumba imara zaidi katika jengo imara.
Usitoke nje hadi mamlaka zitangaze kuwa upepo umepita.
Jengo likianza kuharibika, hamia kona imara zaidi na linda kichwa chako.

impact.en: Deaths and injuries from flying debris, collapsing buildings and falling trees
impact.sw: Vifo na majeruhi kutokana na vitu vinavyopeperushwa, majengo kuanguka na miti kuanguka

en: Keep away from windows and outer walls.
Call 190 or 114 to report trapped or injured people.
Fire and Rescue Force: lead search and rescue with the Police Force and the Red Cross.
sw: Kaa mbali na madirisha na kuta za nje.
Piga 190 au 114 kutoa taarifa ya watu waliokwama au kujeruhiwa.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji: ongozeni utafutaji na uokoaji kwa kushirikiana na Jeshi la Polisi na Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu.

impact.en: Collapse of buildings, especially mud-walled houses and weak roofs
impact.sw: Kuanguka kwa majengo, hasa nyumba za tope na zenye paa dhaifu

en: Do not enter collapsed or damaged buildings.
Go to official shelters.
Please return only when the authorities declare the area safe.
sw: Usiingie kwenye majengo yaliyoanguka au kuharibika.
Nenda kwenye makazi rasmi ya muda.
Tafadhali rudini pale tu mamlaka zitakapotangaza kuwa eneo ni salama.

impact.en: Power cuts lasting several days
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa umeme kwa siku kadhaa

en: Use generators only outdoors, away from doors and windows.
Use stored water and food sparingly.
District Committees: set up emergency water points and mobile health services.
sw: Tumia jenereta nje tu, mbali na milango na madirisha.
Tumia akiba ya maji na chakula kwa uangalifu.
Kamati za Wilaya: anzisheni vituo vya dharura vya maji na huduma za afya za mkoba.

impact.en: Major disruption to road, rail, air and water transport
impact.sw: Usumbufu mkubwa wa usafiri wa barabara, reli, anga na majini

en: Do not travel.
Keep emergency routes clear.
Follow directives from the Police and transport authorities.
sw: Usisafiri.
Acha wazi njia za dharura.
Fuata maelekezo ya Polisi na mamlaka za usafiri.

impact.en: Damage to ports, landing sites and fishing communities
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa bandari, mialo na jamii za wavuvi

en: All boats stay ashore on the sea and lakes.
Boats caught out: go to the nearest safe shore.
District Committees and Beach Management Units: account for all fishers and report the missing to the Police.
sw: Vyombo vyote vibaki ufukweni baharini na maziwani.
Vyombo vilivyo majini: nendeni ufukwe salama ulio karibu.
Kamati za Wilaya na Vikundi vya Usimamizi wa Mialo (BMU): hakikisheni wavuvi wote wanajulikana walipo na toeni taarifa ya waliopotea kwa Polisi.

impact.en: Severe damage to crops, livestock and food stores
impact.sw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa mazao, mifugo na akiba ya chakula

en: Move food stores into solid buildings.
Keep livestock in sheltered places away from trees.
Report losses to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Hamishia akiba ya chakula kwenye majengo imara.
Weka mifugo mahali pa kujikinga mbali na miti.
Toa taarifa ya hasara kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Communication networks down
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa mitandao ya mawasiliano

en: Listen to official radio broadcasts.
Rely only on official information.
District Committees: use radio and messengers to reach cut-off villages.
sw: Sikiliza matangazo rasmi ya redio.
Tegemea taarifa rasmi tu.
Kamati za Wilaya: tumieni redio na wajumbe kufikia vijiji visivyofikika.

impact.en: Large-scale evacuation of people required
impact.sw: Uhamishaji mkubwa wa watu unahitajika

en: Households in weak houses: move to a solid building or official shelter before the winds arrive.
Register at the shelter.
Help older persons, children, pregnant women and people with disabilities first.
sw: Kaya zilizo kwenye nyumba dhaifu: hamieni jengo imara au makazi rasmi ya muda kabla upepo haujafika.
Jisajili kwenye makazi ya muda.
Wasaidie wazee, watoto, wajawazito na watu wenye ulemavu kwanza.

impact.en: Widespread closure of schools and businesses
impact.sw: Kufungwa kwa shule na biashara katika maeneo mengi

en: Keep children at home or in safe shelters under adult supervision.
School heads: open school buildings as shelters only when directed by the District Committee.
Schools reopen only after the District Education Office confirms that buildings are safe.
sw: Waweke watoto nyumbani au katika makazi salama chini ya uangalizi wa watu wazima.
Wakuu wa shule: fungueni majengo ya shule kama makazi ya muda pale tu Kamati ya Wilaya itakapoelekeza.
Shule zifunguliwe tena baada tu ya Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya kuthibitisha usalama wa majengo.

impact.en: Fires spread rapidly by the wind
impact.sw: Moto kusambaa kwa kasi kutokana na upepo

en: Do not light fires outdoors.
Put out cooking fires and charcoal stoves when not in use.
Report fires immediately: call 114.
sw: Usiwashe moto nje.
Zima moto wa kupikia na majiko ya mkaa yasipotumika.
Toa taarifa ya moto mara moja: piga 114.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please stay with official sources: radio, TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
Disaster Management Committees will announce when the danger has passed and when it is safe to return.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa rasmi: redio, TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa zitatangaza hatari itakapokwisha na itakapokuwa salama kurudi.
